block: Block: Accept mixed-row continuation and correction evidence
title: Accept mixed-row continuation and correction evidence
precondition: A mixed-result batch and its rejection report are available.

steps.action: Reconcile accepted work against the batch summary.
Confirm that each rejected row has actionable correction detail.
Agree whether valid work may proceed while rejected rows are corrected.

expectedOutcome: Valid delivery work is accepted for planning while every rejected row remains owned and explainable.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision prevents a few bad rows from hiding valid demand or silently disappearing.
fingerprint: uat|delivery intake|accept mixed-row continuation and correction evidence|this decision prevents a few bad rows from hiding valid demand or silently disappearing.

block: Block: Accept route-and-date draft completeness
title: Accept route-and-date draft completeness
precondition: The intake batch and resulting current drafts are available.

steps.action: Compare eligible demand by route and date with the draft population.
Review totals for representative drafts.
Decide whether the current draft set is complete for the planning window.

expectedOutcome: Exactly one current, reconcilable draft represents each route/date with eligible work.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision is the entry gate to recommendation and assignment.
fingerprint: uat|planning readiness|accept route-and-date draft completeness|this decision is the entry gate to recommendation and assignment.

block: Block: Accept ordered-stop and skipped-work transparency
title: Accept ordered-stop and skipped-work transparency
precondition: A representative draft contains active and skipped stops.

steps.action: Compare the displayed stop order with the approved route sequence.
Review the business reason and totals for skipped work.
Decide whether the draft accurately represents the delivery route.

expectedOutcome: Active work follows the approved sequence and skipped work remains visible without inflating delivery totals.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision protects route integrity and prevents hidden omissions.
fingerprint: uat|planning readiness|accept ordered-stop and skipped-work transparency|this decision protects route integrity and prevents hidden omissions.

block: Block: Accept planned departure and ETA usability
title: Accept planned departure and ETA usability
precondition: A representative draft has complete route and timing data.

steps.action: Review departure and ETA evidence for the operating day.
Challenge one approved departure-time change and compare the refreshed schedule.
Decide whether the schedule is operationally usable within the common working window.

expectedOutcome: The accepted schedule has understandable stop timing that responds coherently to the dispatcher decision.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision confirms that timing information is fit for assignment, not merely calculated.
fingerprint: uat|planning readiness|accept planned departure and eta usability|this decision confirms that timing information is fit for assignment, not merely calculated.

block: Block: Accept separate payload and volume feasibility
title: Accept separate payload and volume feasibility
precondition: Representative feasible and constrained drafts are available.

steps.action: Review payload and volume utilisation as separate business measures.
Confirm that the limiting measure is visible for the constrained case.
Decide whether the feasibility result is safe for fleet assignment.

expectedOutcome: Only allocations within both usable limits are accepted as feasible.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision prevents a plan from passing on weight while failing on cargo volume, or vice versa.
fingerprint: uat|capacity governance|accept separate payload and volume feasibility|this decision prevents a plan from passing on weight while failing on cargo volume, or vice versa.

block: Block: Accept a two-vehicle fallback decision
title: Accept a two-vehicle fallback decision
precondition: No one-vehicle plan is feasible and a validated pair exists.

steps.action: Review why the single-vehicle option is not feasible.
Verify that the proposed pair covers the whole delivery scope once.
Decide whether the two-vehicle allocation is acceptable for operation.

expectedOutcome: The business accepts a complete two-vehicle plan without forcing an unsafe single vehicle.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision preserves capacity safety while keeping deliverable demand in the plan.
recovery: Reject the plan and return it to planning if either allocation is incomplete or infeasible.
fingerprint: uat|capacity governance|accept a two-vehicle fallback decision|this decision preserves capacity safety while keeping deliverable demand in the plan.

block: Block: Accept explainable ranked alternatives
title: Accept explainable ranked alternatives
precondition: A recommendation run contains representative feasible alternatives.

steps.action: Review the ranking, resources, utilisation, cost indicator, and warnings.
Ask the dispatcher to explain why the preferred plan is operationally suitable.
Decide whether the alternatives provide enough evidence for a planning choice.

expectedOutcome: The decision maker can understand and defend the selected alternative without hidden scoring assumptions.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision validates explainability and operational trust in recommendation output.
fingerprint: uat|recommendation decision|accept explainable ranked alternatives|this decision validates explainability and operational trust in recommendation output.

block: Block: Reject an unexplained no-feasible result
title: Reject an unexplained no-feasible result
precondition: A test planning set has no feasible allocation.

steps.action: Review the no-feasible result and its limiting categories.
Determine whether the stated limits correspond to the known fleet and demand.
Decide whether the result provides an actionable re-planning direction.

expectedOutcome: A no-feasible result is acceptable only when it identifies the principal constraint and next business action.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision prevents an empty recommendation from becoming an unexplained operational dead end.
recovery: Return the draft for data correction, capacity change, or authorised re-planning based on the displayed constraint.
fingerprint: uat|recommendation decision|reject an unexplained no-feasible result|this decision prevents an empty recommendation from becoming an unexplained operational dead end.

block: Block: Accept the selected-plan commitment and audit basis
title: Accept the selected-plan commitment and audit basis
precondition: A current recommendation set and confirmed planning evidence are available.

steps.action: Identify the alternative selected by the dispatcher.
Review the resources, planning version, and decision ownership captured at confirmation.
Decide whether the confirmed plan is the authorised operational commitment.

expectedOutcome: The accepted confirmation is singular, attributable, and tied to the reviewed planning evidence.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision creates the governed boundary between analysis and operational commitment.
fingerprint: uat|planning commitment|accept the selected-plan commitment and audit basis|this decision creates the governed boundary between analysis and operational commitment.

block: Block: Accept controlled withdrawal before execution
title: Accept controlled withdrawal before execution
precondition: A confirmed plan requires an approved change before trip execution.

steps.action: Review the original confirmation and change reason.
Confirm that the withdrawn decision remains traceable.
Decide whether the draft may re-enter planning under controlled ownership.

expectedOutcome: The original decision remains auditable while the current draft is available for re-planning.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision prevents operational changes from erasing planning accountability.
fingerprint: uat|planning commitment|accept controlled withdrawal before execution|this decision prevents operational changes from erasing planning accountability.

block: Block: Accept one accountable driver per selected vehicle
title: Accept one accountable driver per selected vehicle
precondition: A confirmed plan and current fleet/driver availability evidence are available.

steps.action: Review the vehicle and driver chosen for each allocation.
Check that availability and licence compatibility support the choice.
Decide whether the assignment is ready for dispatch publication.

expectedOutcome: Each selected vehicle has one accountable, eligible driver and no unresolved resource conflict.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision establishes clear ownership of the physical delivery work.
fingerprint: uat|resource assignment|accept one accountable driver per selected vehicle|this decision establishes clear ownership of the physical delivery work.

block: Block: Accept loading guidance for the assigned route
title: Accept loading guidance for the assigned route
actor: Warehouse lead and assigned driver representative
precondition: The final assignment and generated loading guidance are available.

steps.action: Compare loading guidance with the assigned stop sequence and order scope.
Review both loading order and by-stop unloading context.
Decide whether the warehouse can load and hand over the vehicle without ambiguity.

expectedOutcome: The accepted guidance covers the assigned orders in a sequence usable by warehouse and driver staff.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision reduces loading mistakes and preserves the planned delivery sequence.
fingerprint: uat|warehouse handoff|accept loading guidance for the assigned route|this decision reduces loading mistakes and preserves the planned delivery sequence.

block: Block: Accept dispatch publication to the assigned driver
title: Accept dispatch publication to the assigned driver
precondition: An eligible assigned trip, dispatch evidence, and driver view are available.

steps.action: Review the dispatch-readiness evidence and final assignment.
Confirm the assigned driver receives the current trip and operational details.
Decide whether the trip has crossed the dispatch handoff boundary successfully.

expectedOutcome: The same current assignment is visible to operations and only its assigned driver.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision proves the cross-channel handoff needed to start delivery work.
fingerprint: uat|dispatch handoff|accept dispatch publication to the assigned driver|this decision proves the cross-channel handoff needed to start delivery work.

block: Block: Accept active-trip progress visibility
title: Accept active-trip progress visibility
precondition: Representative active trips include pending, completed, and exception work.

steps.action: Review the fleet-level operating picture.
Drill into a representative trip and reconcile stop/order progress.
Decide whether operations can identify where intervention is required.

expectedOutcome: Stakeholders can move from aggregate trip status to the affected operational work.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision validates control-room usefulness rather than mere dashboard rendering.
fingerprint: uat|operational control|accept active-trip progress visibility|this decision validates control-room usefulness rather than mere dashboard rendering.

block: Block: Accept exception ownership and resolution evidence
title: Accept exception ownership and resolution evidence
precondition: A representative unresolved exception and its resolution evidence are available.

steps.action: Review how the exception is linked to trip and delivery context.
Evaluate the resolution note, owner, and resolution time.
Decide whether the exception can be closed with adequate accountability.

expectedOutcome: The resolved exception remains linked to its operational cause and accountable resolution.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision ensures exceptions are governed business records, not transient alerts.
fingerprint: uat|exception governance|accept exception ownership and resolution evidence|this decision ensures exceptions are governed business records, not transient alerts.

block: Block: Accept a completed trip outcome for validation
title: Accept a completed trip outcome for validation
precondition: A completed trip has a submitted outcome and supporting execution evidence.

steps.action: Compare the submitted outcome with trip, stop, order, and exception evidence.
Review ownership and completion timing.
Decide whether the outcome is fit for validation.

expectedOutcome: Only a coherent submitted outcome is accepted as validated operational history.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision controls which completed-trip evidence may inform reporting and future analysis.
fingerprint: uat|outcome governance|accept a completed trip outcome for validation|this decision controls which completed-trip evidence may inform reporting and future analysis.

block: Block: Accept audited correction without erasing prior values
title: Accept audited correction without erasing prior values
precondition: An outcome correction request and resulting event timeline are available.

steps.action: Review the original submitted values and correction reason.
Review the actor, time, and new outcome state in the timeline.
Decide whether the correction preserves an adequate audit trail.

expectedOutcome: The correction is accepted only when prior values and decision history remain available.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision protects the integrity of operational history.
fingerprint: uat|outcome governance|accept audited correction without erasing prior values|this decision protects the integrity of operational history.

block: Block: Accept KPI use of validated outcomes
title: Accept KPI use of validated outcomes
precondition: Validated and non-validated outcome samples exist in the reporting period.

steps.action: Review the outcome population eligible for reporting.
Compare a KPI summary and trend with the validated sample.
Decide whether the indicators are suitable for operational review.

expectedOutcome: Management indicators reflect validated outcomes and support an explainable operational decision.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision prevents provisional or correction-pending outcomes from distorting management reporting.
fingerprint: uat|management review|accept kpi use of validated outcomes|this decision prevents provisional or correction-pending outcomes from distorting management reporting.

block: Block: Accept end-to-end planning and outcome traceability
title: Accept end-to-end planning and outcome traceability
precondition: Known planning and outcome events exist for a representative delivery cycle.

steps.action: Trace the cycle from intake and planning decision to execution outcome.
Identify the responsible actors and event times at material decisions.
Decide whether the evidence is sufficient for an audit inquiry.

expectedOutcome: The delivery cycle can be reconstructed without altering historical records.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision establishes audit readiness across planning and execution boundaries.
fingerprint: uat|audit review|accept end-to-end planning and outcome traceability|this decision establishes audit readiness across planning and execution boundaries.

block: Block: Accept route, store, vehicle, and product readiness
title: Accept route, store, vehicle, and product readiness
actor: System administrator, planner, and fleet owner
precondition: Representative approved master-data records and their planning attributes are available.

steps.action: Review store-to-route mapping and ordered stops.
Review vehicle capacity/licence data and product physical attributes.
Decide whether the master-data set is safe to use in planning.

expectedOutcome: The accepted records are complete, coherent, and governed for planning use.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision prevents planning from relying on incomplete or contradictory master data.
fingerprint: uat|master data readiness|accept route, store, vehicle, and product readiness|this decision prevents planning from relying on incomplete or contradictory master data.

block: Block: Accept least-privilege administration
title: Accept least-privilege administration
precondition: Representative roles and non-self test users are available.

steps.action: Review approved role responsibilities against assigned permissions.
Review a governed user role/status change.
Decide whether administration enforces least privilege and preserves administrator continuity.

expectedOutcome: Administrative access matches approved responsibilities without allowing unsafe self-removal.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision protects critical configuration and operational data.
fingerprint: uat|access governance|accept least-privilege administration|this decision protects critical configuration and operational data.

block: Block: Accept driver availability governance
title: Accept driver availability governance
precondition: A driver status transition and assignment availability evidence are available.

steps.action: Review the business reason for the driver status change.
Confirm the assignment view reflects current availability.
Decide whether the driver may be considered for new work.

expectedOutcome: Driver eligibility decisions use current, attributable availability status.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision prevents unavailable drivers from entering operational assignments.
fingerprint: uat|fleet readiness|accept driver availability governance|this decision prevents unavailable drivers from entering operational assignments.

block: Block: Accept controlled trip start and stop progress
title: Accept controlled trip start and stop progress
precondition: A dispatched trip and representative next stop are available.

steps.action: Review the driver confirmation and resulting trip start.
Review the recorded arrival and updated stop progress.
Decide whether operational state changes are clear and attributable.

expectedOutcome: The driver and supervisor agree that trip and stop progress reflect the performed work.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision confirms the usability of the core execution-state workflow.
fingerprint: uat|driver operations|accept controlled trip start and stop progress|this decision confirms the usability of the core execution-state workflow.

block: Block: Accept exception-aware trip completion
title: Accept exception-aware trip completion
precondition: Representative normal and exception delivery results are available.

steps.action: Review how the driver records normal completion and a reasoned delivery exception.
Review the resulting trip completion classification and submitted outcome.
Decide whether the operational record accurately distinguishes normal and exception completion.

expectedOutcome: The completed trip and submitted outcome preserve terminal delivery results and required exception reasons.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision connects driver evidence to trustworthy outcome governance.
fingerprint: uat|driver operations|accept exception-aware trip completion|this decision connects driver evidence to trustworthy outcome governance.

block: Block: Accept session termination across Web and Mobile
title: Accept session termination across Web and Mobile
precondition: Approved Web and Mobile sessions are available for controlled sign-out.

steps.action: End each representative session using its normal user flow.
Attempt to return to protected operational content.
Decide whether terminated sessions protect business information consistently.

expectedOutcome: Both channels require a new approved sign-in before protected work is available again.
acceptanceSignificance: This decision confirms a consistent business security boundary across user channels.
fingerprint: uat|session security|accept session termination across web and mobile|this decision confirms a consistent business security boundary across user channels.
